title: Aave收到LlamaRisk冻结StakeWise、Lombard和Rocket Pool代币的提案
originalTitle: LlamaRisk Asks Aave to Freeze StakeWise, Lombard and Rocket Pool Tokens on Its V3 Core Market
summary: LlamaRisk向AaveDAO提议冻结StakeWise的osETH（质押ETH）、Lombard的LBTC（比特币相关）和Rocket Pool的rETH（流动质押ETH）代币，涉及$538.6 million抵押品和$364.1 million债务。
author: Unchained
